name: decoder_moe_m32_stack_v1
hypothesis: Stack the validated public M32 MoE kernel only on the decoder 32-row route where it improved; retain current WM on the losing 128-row route. Shape dispatch isolates the measured complementary gain.
decision_reason: Official full coverage passed 13/13 tests, but aggregate 1.702752x is below current private best 1.707723x (confidence intervals overlap); shape-only M32 dispatch did not yield a repeatable whole-decoder gain. Keep decoder_stack_v3.
